title: Calls only between 8:00 am and 7:00 pm
rule_text: Recovery calls must not be made before 8:00 a.m. or after 7:00 p.m. (borrower local time). A stricter lender window overrides.
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 32; RBI Press Release 2022-2023/707 (12 Aug 2022)

title: No persistent calling (daily / weekly call limits)
rule_text: Persistent calling of the borrower is prohibited. The numeric daily and weekly limits come from the lender's Fair Practices Code (RBI sets no number).
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 32 (principle); limits from lender FPC v4.2 (POL-GEN-002/003)

title: Agent holds a valid DRA certificate on the call date
rule_text: Only recovery agents with a valid certificate on the date of the call may contact borrowers.

title: Identity verified before disclosing dues
rule_text: The agent must verify the person is the borrower before discussing or disclosing any amount due.

title: Connected calls recorded and retained
rule_text: Every connected call must be recorded and the recording or transcript retained for at least 24 months.

title: No threatening, abusive or misleading language on calls
rule_text: No intimidation, threats, humiliation or false and misleading representations to the borrower.
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 32; RBI Press Release 2022-2023/707 (12 Aug 2022)

title: Calls only from the dedicated 160-series number
rule_text: Recovery calls should come from the lender's dedicated 160-series number.
source_ref: Dedicated 160-series number (telecom-regulator rule, not confirmed as an RBI text); data is illustrative

title: WhatsApp consent before contact
rule_text: WhatsApp messages only where consent was captured before the message and not opted out at that time.

title: SMS consent before contact
rule_text: SMS only where consent was captured before the message and not opted out at that time.
source_ref: Digital Communication Policy v1.3 (POL-GEN-007, applied to SMS)

title: Voice-call consent before contact
rule_text: Calls only where voice consent was captured before the call and not opted out at that time.
source_ref: Digital Communication Policy v1.3 (POL-GEN-007, applied to voice)

title: WhatsApp messages use an approved template
rule_text: Every WhatsApp message must use a WhatsApp template approved on or before the sending date.

title: No inappropriate messages on mobile or social media
rule_text: Messages that humiliate, threaten or intrude on the borrower's privacy are prohibited.
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 32

title: Demand and pre-legal notices served on time
rule_text: Demand notice within 7 business days and pre-legal notice within 10 business days of the trigger, with proof of delivery.

title: Field visits only between 09:00 and 18:00
rule_text: Field visits only within the permitted hours (09:00 to 18:00).

title: Securities released after the loan is paid
rule_text: All securities must be released on payment or realisation of the loan.
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 24

title: Penal charges disclosed in reminders
rule_text: Reminders for non-compliance must state the applicable penal charges, which may not be capitalised.
source_ref: RBI (AIFI - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/336 para 30(1), 30(7)
